title: Sculpt and paint a terrain
description: Make hills and valleys with brushes, paint grass and rock, then let rules paint the whole terrain.

steps.title: Create a terrain
steps.text: Add Object ▸ 3D Object ▸ Terrain. A flat piece of land appears and is selected.

steps.title: Raise and lower
steps.text: Pick the first tool, Raise or Lower Terrain. Click and drag on the terrain in the Editor Scene to make hills. Hold Shift to dig down.

steps.title: Change the brush
steps.text: Brush Size sets how wide the brush is. Opacity sets how fast it works. A big, soft brush makes nice mountains.

steps.title: Smooth it out
steps.text: Pick Smooth Height (≈) and paint over sharp bumps to soften them.

steps.title: Make flat ground
steps.text: Pick Set Height (⊟), choose a Height and paint. The ground moves to that height, good for roads or a village.

steps.title: Add a texture layer
steps.text: Pick Paint Texture (🖌) and click + Add Layer. Each layer is one kind of ground.

steps.title: Pick grass
steps.text: Click the Diffuse slot and pick a grass texture. The first layer covers the whole terrain.

steps.title: Add rock
steps.text: Click + Add Layer again and give the new layer a rock texture. You can name it Rock.

steps.title: Paint by hand
steps.text: With the rock layer selected, paint on the terrain in the Editor Scene. Rock shows up where you paint.

steps.title: Rock on steep slopes
steps.text: Open Auto Paint Rules and tick Rule-driven. Set Slope to about 30° to 90°: rock now belongs on steep slopes.

steps.title: Grass on flat ground
steps.text: Click the grass layer in Layers. Make it Rule-driven too, with Slope 0° to 30°.

steps.title: Generate
steps.text: Click Generate. The rules paint the whole terrain at once. Change a rule and Generate again to try new ideas fast.
